name: Scott Peters
stance: Wants uniform national transparency and safety standards for the most advanced AI rather than a fifty-state patchwork, and warns the window to get AI policy right is closing.

statements.text: Original cosponsor of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act setting transparency and safety standards for the most advanced AI systems.
The window to get AI policy right is closing, and Congress can't afford to miss it,
a targeted bill with clear, uniform transparency, and safety standards, instead of a fifty-state patchwork
AI is moving faster than Congress is moving to regulate it. That's a problem regardless of party. We need a bipartisan framework that protects Americans without choking off innovation
Joined the Problem Solvers Caucus AI working group in a letter urging the Trump administration to lead on global AI safety and security ahead of President Trump's meeting with President Xi.

review.note: added October 2026; FRONTIER Act record verified via the lead sponsors' primary release; quotes verified verbatim
